reference.title: BacnetOwsDeviceFolder
reference.shortdesc: This component implements a folder under a BacnetOwsNetwork.

section.p: Typically, you add such folders using the New Folder button in the Bacnet Ows Device Manager view of the BacnetOwsNetwork. Each BacnetOwsDeviceFolder has its own Bacnet Ows Device Manager view. This folder is also available in the bacnetOws palette.
